local_verification.native_skip_semantics: Native tests require the explicitly supplied isolated RHash library; no system-library discovery or fallback is admitted.

remote_synthetic_verification.scope: Synthetic ZIPs, explicit native checkpoint round trips, mocked source transport, and mocked CLI dispatch only. No PoseIt archive request or payload is part of the test bundle.

tested_contracts: A complete registered checkpoint custody chain and an externally pinned acquisition receipt are required before any structure request.
A separate exact structure authorization binds source, implementation, host, fixed output and external ledger paths, scope, bounds, cooldown, and one attempt.
Refetched whole acquisition chunks must match their retained SHA-256 values before any requested ZIP slice is returned to the original parser.
Opaque neighboring compressed bytes may be buffered transiently; no member payload is decompressed or persisted.
Actual network attempts are distinguished from memory adapter responses; HTTP rejection and exhausted socket retries cannot trigger a nested parser retry.
ZIP and ZIP64 structure parsing succeeds on synthetic inputs without opening member payloads.
Missing custody, altered authorization/code bindings, wrong source bytes, unsafe archive paths, linked outputs, concurrent locks, and interrupted publication fail closed.
Deleting output does not release the external attempt ledger. Failure never automatically retries.
Offline publication verification requires matching private/public records, exact external result hash, complete terminal custody, and ordered timestamps. It does not rehash unavailable raw data.

production_state_after_qualification.observed_by: Direct SSH stat of the five exact registered paths; all returned no such file or directory.

remaining_gates: After the existing cooldown and fresh process/identity checks, consume the already frozen initial acquisition authorization exactly once using the unchanged acquisition implementation.
Complete and verify the full archive SHA-256 and checkpoint custody. Preserve any failure without automatic restart.
Only then complete and review a separate structure authorization binding the actual receipt and exact integration implementation. No such real authorization is issued by this qualification.
Run and verify the one-shot structure inventory; qualify the new schema for the unchanged archive-specific mapping and object-role gates before decoding any sensor or phase payload.
Follow the frozen fit/calibration, sealed source-test, source gate, and one-shot confirmation sequence. No scientific benefit has been established.
